description: Draft a song concept for a child’s first name and a theme: title, music style, companion character, a chorus with the name and a 4-part verse outline, plus 3 CucuTime YouTube videos on the theme. Useful for a personalized, birthday or bedtime song idea for a named child, before writing lyrics or creating audio. Returns text and links, not audio. Free, no key, no AI.

language.description: Output language matching the request (en, es or pt; default en).

name.description: Child’s first name only (no surnames or personal data).

theme.description: Occasion, topic or style (e.g. birthday, bedtime, animals, dinosaurs, space, bravery, starting preschool).
